title: Consolidated Financial Statements
summary: The IASC's original consolidation standard, establishing line-by-line combination of subsidiary financial statements. Superseded in 1989 by IAS 27 and IAS 28, and later by IFRS 10, IFRS 11, and IFRS 12.
